source_title: Hospital chains urge Centre to withdraw ban on reuse of single-use devices
source_excerpt:
Hospital chains seek regulated reuse of single-use medical devices, warning that a blanket ban could raise procedure costs by 25-75% and disrupt dialysis services for nearly 500,000 patients.
Leading hospital chains have urged the government to reconsider its ban on reusing single-use medical devices, warning of a 25-75% rise in procedure costs and potential disruption to dialysis services.
Dialysis services face immediate challenge
Industry seeks transition time of 3-6 months
